state.lastRunNotes: Board-wide rally continues (BTC +8% today) driven by Trump-Xi summit optimism and $2B+ of spot BTC ETF inflows this week - broad macro/beta, not fresh idiosyncratic catalysts for any single name. NEAR, UNI, AVAX, BCH and LTC are all still running on catalysts already priced in when bought (Hyperliquid/Ondo for NEAR, CME futures Oct 19 for UNI/BCH, Helicon/Aave RWA for AVAX, Coinbase loan collateral for LTC), so holding rather than adding into the pump. No other watchlist name shows genuine unusual volume (vol_x) or a new specific catalyst. Growth/core split stays near 45/55, within band; cash at 34% is comfortably above the 5% floor.

rescaled.note: Scaled from a separate portfolio into an A$10,000 slice of one A$40,000 fund on 2026-09-25.

trades.horizon: Reassess at next FOMC meeting or if weekly ETF flows turn net-negative for 2 consecutive weeks
trades.rationale: US spot BTC ETFs took in $3.52B in August with only 5/21 sessions seeing outflows; over $648M in short positions unwound as price broke above $85k, and BTC is on a rare three-month winning streak. Establishing core position on this institutional-flow catalyst despite today's intraday pullback on rising bond yields.
trades.sentimentSummary: Bullish institutional flow narrative, but short-term choppy as yields rise; mixed but net positive.
